navigation.route_description: Enter through the Main Hospital Entrance and proceed straight for approximately 20 meters. The Emergency Department is immediately on the left beside the ambulance bay.
Walk straight past Reception and continue along the OPD corridor. General Medicine is located on the right.
Proceed to Lift A, go to the first floor, turn left, and continue until reaching the Cardiology reception.
Exit the visitor parking area using the covered walkway. Enter through the main doors where the Reception Desk is directly ahead.
From Reception, walk toward the Patient Services Block. The Pharmacy is located opposite the Billing Counter.

From Reception, proceed straight through the main corridor toward the Diagnostic Services Block. Continue past the Billing Counter and follow the Laboratory signs. The Central Laboratory is located on the ground floor.
Walk straight toward the Diagnostic Center following the Radiology signs. The department is located opposite the Emergency corridor.
Proceed toward the Diagnostic Services Block and continue to the Blood Bank located beside the Central Laboratory entrance.
Walk toward Lift D, go to the first floor, and follow the Critical Care signs. The ICU entrance is secured and located beside the Cardiac ICU.
Walk through the Surgical Services corridor. The General Surgery department is located adjacent to the Operation Theatre complex.
From the main parking area, use the Emergency Entrance located on the east side of the hospital. Follow the red Emergency signs directly to the Emergency Department reception.

navigation.route_name: Parking Area to Intensive Care Unit
navigation.route_description: Enter through the Main Entrance from the parking area, proceed to Lift D, go to the first floor, and follow the Critical Care signs to the ICU.
Enter through the Main Entrance and continue straight past Reception. The Pharmacy is located on the right side beside the Billing Counter.
From the Main Entrance, proceed through Reception and take Lift B to the second floor. Follow the Child Care signs to Pediatrics.
Walk through Reception and take Lift C to the second floor. Follow the Women's Health signs to the Obstetrics & Gynecology department.
Enter through the Main Entrance and walk past Reception. Continue to Lift B, go to the second floor, then follow the blue Orthopedics signs to the department.
Walk straight from the Main Entrance to Reception. Take Lift A to the third floor and follow the Neurology directional signs.
From the Main Entrance proceed through Reception. Continue to Lift A, travel to the second floor, and follow the Heart Care signs to Cardiology.
After entering the Main Entrance, walk past Reception toward Lift D. Take the lift to the fourth floor and follow the Cancer Care signs.
Enter through the Main Entrance, continue to Reception, then take Lift C to the third floor. Follow the Kidney Care signs to the Nephrology Department.
Walk straight from the Main Entrance to the Reception Desk. Continue to Lift C, travel to the third floor, and follow the Respiratory Care signs to the Pulmonology Department.
From the Main Entrance proceed past Reception, take Lift B to the first floor, and follow the Skin Care signs to Dermatology.
Walk through Reception and continue toward Lift A. Take the lift to the first floor and follow the Ear, Nose & Throat signs.
Proceed from the Main Entrance to Reception. Take Lift B to the second floor and follow the Eye Care signs to Ophthalmology.
Enter through the Main Entrance, continue to Reception, take Lift D to the second floor, and follow the Hormone & Diabetes Care signs to Endocrinology.
Enter through the Main Entrance and walk straight to Reception. Take Lift C to the third floor and follow the Mental Health Services signs to the Psychiatry Department.
Walk through the Main Entrance and continue to Reception. Take Lift D to the third floor and follow the Urology directional signs.
Proceed from the Main Entrance to Reception, take Lift B to the second floor, and follow the Digestive Health signs to Gastroenterology.

From the Main Reception, walk straight through the central corridor for approximately 35 meters. Turn left at the Diagnostic Services signboard. The Central Laboratory is the second department on the right.
Walk straight from the reception and follow the blue directional signs toward Diagnostic Imaging. Radiology is located opposite the CT Scan waiting area.
Proceed along the main lobby toward the outpatient exit. The Pharmacy is located beside the Billing & Insurance counter.
Walk straight ahead from the reception. The Billing & Insurance department is situated next to the Pharmacy.
Exit the Emergency Department through the critical care corridor. Continue straight until the secured ICU entrance.
Follow the emergency services corridor and turn right after Radiology. The Blood Bank is located adjacent to the Laboratory wing.
Take the imaging corridor directly from Emergency. Radiology is immediately accessible for emergency diagnostic procedures.
Walk through the diagnostic services hallway. The Central Laboratory is located beside the Blood Collection Center.
Exit the ward through the central corridor and continue toward the outpatient lobby. The Pharmacy is beside the Billing section.
Proceed through the visitor corridor toward the main lobby. Billing & Insurance is located opposite the Pharmacy.
Enter through the main entrance and continue straight into the hospital lobby. The Reception & Information Desk is centrally located immediately inside the entrance.
From the Visitor Parking area, enter through the Emergency Entrance located on the east side of the hospital. Emergency Medicine is immediately inside the entrance.
Enter through the main entrance, continue toward the Diagnostic Services corridor, and follow the Blood Bank signs.
Walk through the main entrance and continue toward the outpatient services area. The Pharmacy is located beside the Billing & Insurance department.
Proceed through the Main Entrance and continue straight into the outpatient lobby. Billing & Insurance is located opposite the Pharmacy.
Exit the ICU through the Critical Care corridor and follow the signs toward Diagnostic Imaging. Radiology is located directly opposite the CT Scan suite.
Leave the ICU and proceed through the emergency services corridor. The Blood Bank is located beside the Central Laboratory.
Follow the corridor connecting ICU to Diagnostic Services. The Central Laboratory is clearly marked beside the Blood Collection Center.
The Reception & Information Desk is centrally located within the Main Lobby near the hospital entrance.
Walk down the administrative corridor behind the Reception Desk. Administration is the first office suite on the left.
Walk straight from Reception toward the outpatient services area. Billing & Insurance is located beside the Pharmacy.
Proceed straight from the Reception Desk into the outpatient services area. The Pharmacy is located immediately next to the Billing & Insurance department.
From the Reception Desk, proceed along the Diagnostic Services corridor. The Central Laboratory is located after the Sample Collection Center on the right.
Walk straight through the Diagnostic Services corridor following the blue Radiology signs. The department is opposite the CT Scan waiting area.
Take the east corridor from Reception and continue until the Cancer Care Wing. Oncology is the second department on the left.
Walk toward the Specialty Clinics corridor. Dentistry is located adjacent to the Oral Surgery consultation rooms.
Proceed through the Mental Health Services corridor. Psychiatry is located opposite the Counseling Center.
Take the specialty clinic corridor toward the Internal Medicine block. Endocrinology is beside the Diabetes Clinic.
Walk through the Internal Medicine corridor and continue until the Digestive Health section. Gastroenterology is clearly signposted.
Follow the Specialty Clinics signs toward the Surgical Block. Urology is located opposite the Renal Clinic.
Proceed toward the Renal Care section on the first floor. Nephrology is adjacent to the Dialysis Unit.
Walk toward the Respiratory Medicine section via the Specialty Clinics corridor. Pulmonology is located beside the Pulmonary Function Testing Lab.
From the Reception Desk, walk along the Pediatric Services corridor. Pediatrics is located opposite the Children's Play Area.
Proceed through the Women's Health corridor from Reception. The Obstetrics & Gynecology department is located beside the Antenatal Clinic.
Walk along the Specialty Clinics corridor and follow the Eye Care signs. Ophthalmology is opposite the Vision Testing Room.
Take the Specialty Clinics corridor and continue until the ENT section located beside the Audiology Room.
Proceed through the outpatient specialty corridor. Dermatology is located next to the Skin Procedure Room.
Walk toward the Surgical Specialty Wing. Orthopedics is located beside the Fracture Clinic.
Proceed to the Neurosciences Wing via the first-floor corridor. Neurology is located beside the EEG Laboratory.
Follow the Heart Care signs toward the Cardiac Wing. Cardiology is located adjacent to the ECG and Echocardiography Unit.
Walk straight from Reception toward the General Outpatient Block. General Medicine is the first consultation area on the left.
Proceed along the Rehabilitation Services corridor. Physiotherapy is located beside the Exercise Therapy Hall.
